verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs explicitly claim workspace, project, repo, branch, environment, and package-level permission controls (bitbucket-docs-9), directly matching the story. However, a hands-on community report describes an admin unable to prevent team members from making repositories public in Bitbucket Cloud, indicating the granular control does not cover all scenarios administrators expect (bitbucket-comm-18). Missing for 10: independent verification of branch-permission granularity working as documented, and no first-party detail on how these permission layers interact or are audited.
